en: The postcard features ornate and elegant early 20th-century design, with decorative fonts and floral hops and barley motifs. It includes three main images: a portrait of a man in historical European dress (possibly a brewery founder or significant figure), the entrance to a grand restaurant with people mingling outside, and the interior of a lavish dining hall with chandeliers and seated guests. Prominent German text references beer and the city of Vienna, suggesting an association with a well-known brewery and restaurant.
